C1009.title: Gold Farming Definition and Income Tiers: Studios Earning 1,000 Yuan Daily
C1009.summary: The article explains that gold farming involves repetitive in-game labor to obtain virtual currency and items, which are then converted into real money. Professional gaming studios use dozens or hundreds of computers, synchronizers, or scripts for batch operations, earning around 1,000 yuan per day. Solo players earn about 20–100 yuan daily.
